Controls help

Space or click/tap: fire, then work the bolt.
WASD or arrows: aim.
Shift+WASD: move your head (turns off mouse follow).
Wheel: zoom.
Drag the lever on the side of the scope: zoom.
Shift+wheel: eye relief.
Phone: turn on Gyro head offset and tilt the phone; with Twist on, tilting the top of the phone to the right adds eye relief.
